# Roleplay Rule 6 - Antagonism and roleplaying as an antagonist..
The goal of antagonists is to create stories and make rounds interesting, for both antagonist players and crew-sided players alike. Antagonists are expected to put in at least some effort towards playing their designated role, though may break with it given sufficient in character reason. Some antagonists are restricted in the ways and quantities they may lend themselves to visiting death and destruction upon the crew.
[bold]For more in-depth antag expecations on individual antags, please see [textlink="19. Antag Expectations" link="RuleR19"][/bold]
## Precedents LRP Specific - Antag objectives are a suggestion, not a rule. However, this does not mean you should be murdering people every shift just for the fun of it. - We've seen antags kill all security and command 100's of times. It's not interesting, if you're seen doing this habitually you will be noted and monitored. - Consider other players fun. Find a reason to kill people, don't do it for no reason. - Traitors may use any item through a surplus crate. If you get a China lake via your gamba, you may use the China lake.
MRP specific - Antags should not be RDMing or RRing people for no reason if your objectives don't ask for it, this does not mean it won’t always be allowed. You could create an elaborate story resulting in the murder of a whole department if the effort is presented. On the crew side, this does not mean you will be baby sat if you decided to rage or think the antag shouldn’t have killed you. Admins reserve the right to decide if they want to punish an antag for overstepping.
Antag specific aims: - Traitors come with objectives, you should not be doing too much if your objectives are to simply steal or teach a person a lesson. We have multiple objectives that allow mass destruction or the murder boning of the station, there's a reason for this. A good rule of thumb is to complete your objectives before you get creative with your disruption of the station.
Traitors get to choose their path via an uplink. You should consider what you are spending your TC on, strategising and making a general effort to make sense of your loadout. You do not need to purchase an undetermined bundle or a surplus crate.
It is encouraged you find other ways to fuck with the station if you're bored. You may cause a situation where you can kill the other person, you may fuck with power, you may cause sec to go on a wild goose chase for you. Just be more interesting than scorched earth.
- Heretics should make an effort to follow their objectives until they ascend, ascension removes this restriction. Using Feast of Owls [add if you want this to release the same restriction or not] - Changelings may kill as they please. See the chart. - Actions as an antagonist do not have to be nefarious or evil, but should make an effort to influence the story and meaningfully impact the shift. Explicitly friendly antagonistic play or siding outright with the crew is restricted – players must have good in-character reasoning behind the decision or an antagonistic goal in mind by doing it. - Roleplay rule 11 applies to the actions of antagonists – extremely repetitive antagonistic actions repeated over the long term may draw an administrative request to tone it down or try something new, if most of the people on the server can immediately guess what you’re going to do when made an antagonist, it might be time to come up with a new plan.
## Important information regarding antag labels. - Traitors and Changelings may team despite being solo antagonists, but risk being a target themselves or double crossed for their biomass or TC. - Heretics do not team, they are explicitly solo antagonists, heretics have conflicting ideologies even if they are the same path. This puts them at odds with each other. The stronger god wins. - Bingles are only interested in feeding the hole. You must feed the hole. - While the abductor may steal non-objective items, it is generally only interested in research. Some trinkets are cool to collect but what use are these normal items? - The Thief antagonist should only deliberately kill in self-defense, while protecting their stash, or after proper escalation. No you may not EMAG the recycler.
Please see roleplay rule 19 for expectations and destruction levels.
